name: vision
title: The Physical AI Crisis & QNX-CortexCage Vision
caption: QNX-CORTEXCAGE: Microkernel-Enforced Simplex Safety Architecture for Physical AI
text: Physical AI is transforming surgical robotics, autonomous vehicles, and aerospace systems. Yet modern neural networks remain non-deterministic black boxes prone to catastrophic hallucinations. Welcome to QNX-CortexCage—a microkernel-enforced, sub-microsecond Simplex Safety Architecture built on QNX Neutrino 8.0 that mathematically guarantees physical AI can never violate real-world safety boundaries.

name: tinyml_architecture
title: Microkernel Architecture & Embedded C TinyML
caption: EMBEDDED 3-LAYER C MLP & MICROKERNEL SCHED_SPORADIC CONTAINMENT
text: Zero cloud APIs. Zero network latency. CortexCage executes a self-contained, three-layer C Multi-Layer Perceptron directly inside QNX user-space in just eighteen microseconds, strictly sandboxed via procmgr ability and sporadic scheduling. Every actuation vector must pass through our POSIX Resource Manager, slash-dev-slash-cortex-gate, governed by a hard real-time one-kilohertz control loop locked at Priority 63.

name: adversarial_jailbreak
title: Live Adversarial AI Jailbreak & 1.39µs CBF Clamping
caption: LIVE ADVERSARIAL JAILBREAK ATTEMPT: 1.39µs SIMPLEX CBF SAFETY PROJECTION
text: Let's launch a live adversarial jailbreak. We command the surgical actuator to breach the cage at negative eight point five meters with a lethal two-hundred-forty Newton-meters of torque. Watch QNX-CortexCage respond in real time: the resource manager intercepts the unsafe vector, evaluates our Control Barrier Function, and projects the trajectory back inside the safe two-point-five-meter envelope at thirty Newton-meters—in just one point three nine microseconds.

name: cpu_storm_flatline
title: 100% CPU Storm & Priority 63 Deterministic Flatline
caption: 100% CPU SATURATION STORM: PRIORITY 63 FIFO ZERO-JITTER DETERMINISM
text: Next, we unleash a one-hundred-percent CPU saturation storm across the AI core. While a general-purpose operating system suffers severe thread starvation and dangerous jitter spikes, look at our one-kilohertz oscilloscope: QNX Neutrino's Priority 63 FIFO scheduler maintains a mathematically flat execution line with zero missed deadlines.

name: fault_healing
title: Fatal SIGSEGV Injection & Sub-500µs Watchdog Self-Healing
caption: FATAL SIGSEGV FAULT ISOLATION: SUB-500µs WATCHDOG SELF-HEALING
text: What happens when the neural planner suffers a fatal segmentation fault? We inject a live SIGSEGV crash. Because QNX isolates every component in protected user-space memory, the actuator loop never blinks. Our Priority 62 High-Availability Watchdog traps the fault and respawns the AI process via posix-spawn in under five hundred microseconds.

name: codelab_outro
title: 6-Module Interactive Codelab & Grand Finale

text: To empower the community, we also ship a complete six-module interactive developer Codelab covering dual-architecture qcc compilation, POSIX resource managers, lock-free shared memory, and bootable IFS generation. QNX-CortexCage proves that physical AI doesn't have to be a gamble. With QNX Neutrino 8.0, autonomy becomes deterministically safe.
